verdict.rationale: Brave Search API ships its own AI-generated output: an Answers endpoint with AI answers grounded in real-time web search and verifiable sources, a summarizer that produces AI summaries of search results, LLM-generated POI descriptions, and intelligent query suggestions. However, these insights are drawn from Brave's web index rather than the user's own data, and they are delivered through API responses rather than inside a product interface. missing for 10: AI insights over the user's own data, an in-product insight/suggestion experience, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality
